listings.title: Cozy Christmas Coloring Book for Adults, 20 Printable Holiday Coloring Pages, Cute Cats, Cocoa, Winter Village, Instant Download PDF
listings.description:
Curl up with a warm drink and color your way into Christmas. This 20-page Cozy Christmas coloring book is packed with snug, heartwarming holiday scenes and lots of little patterns to fill in, perfect for relaxing evenings this season.

THE 20 PAGES
• Kitty asleep under the Christmas tree
• Ornate holly and pinecone wreath with bells
• Cat in a Santa hat at a frosty window
• Festive snowflake and candy cane mandala
• Cozy reading nook with quilt and lantern
• Vintage truck bringing home the tree
• Kitten peeking out of a gift box
• Santa's workshop with elves and toys
• Snowy village street with lampposts
• Fox and bunny cuddled under a pine
• Christmas baking table with gingerbread
• Cat napping by the fireplace and stockings
• Patterned Christmas ornaments
• Decorated front porch with sled and lanterns
• Snow globe cottage with candles
• Teddy bear with cocoa by the window
• Gingerbread house village
• Reindeer with ornament antlers
• Christmas bakery shop front
• Hot cocoa with marshmallows and cookies

WHAT'S INCLUDED
• 20 coloring pages
• US Letter (8.5x11 in) PDF + PNG
• A4 PDF + PNG
• 300 DPI crisp black line art, print as many times as you like

GREAT FOR
Cozy nights in, holiday stress relief, family coloring time, stocking stuffers, Christmas party activities, classrooms and a sweet last-minute gift.

This is an INSTANT DIGITAL DOWNLOAD. No physical item will be shipped. Because of the nature of digital files, all sales are final, but message me if anything is wrong with your files and I'll make it right.

LICENSE: Personal use, and printing for your own family or classroom. Please do not resell or share the files.

CUSTOM ORDERS: want a special theme or a page made just for you? Send me a message!

—
Made by Freemans DocHub with the help of digital/AI art tools; every page is hand-selected, cleaned up and print-prepared by me.
